text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well now, you are quite adept...! 
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No need to even grade it—you pass with 
flying colors. 
A truly splendid performance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In this discipline, perhaps I ought 
to look upon you as my master.
choice_data_list: Huh?! It wasn't that big a deal...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Nay, do not be modest. 
When next the opportunity arises, I shall 
surely seek your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Let us take these back to the club at 
once. 
...Fufu, but truly, this is more than 
enough. 
The others are sure to be delighted.
